description.value:
Rank 4 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: 8 Ki per ki blast
  • Prerequisites: 1 Star in Ki Blast Barrage and Rapid Fire!
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 60 Feet
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Barrage

Fire a barrage of individual small ki blasts. Roll a number Barrage Attack Roll up to but not exceeding your Proficiency Bonus for 8 Ki per Barrage Attack Roll, each dealing your Basic Ki Blast Damage Die on a hit.

system.requirements: 1 Star in *Ki Blast Barrage* and *Rapid Fire!*
